final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT projects.fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN scanspatial.boxy IS NOT NULL AND scanspatial.boxz IS NOT NULL AND scanspatial.boxz != 0 THEN scanspatial.boxy / scanspatial.boxz ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanspatial JOIN projects ON scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY projects.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(step1.record_count) as avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.fundflux, step1.avg_ratio, step1.record_count, step1.record_count - step2.avg_count as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.record_count > step2.avg_count) SELECT AVG(step3.avg_ratio), SUM(step3.record_count), AVG(step3.diff) FROM step3    -- The answer is (2.8305526169908615, 521, 10.5): average bounding-box Y/Z ratio of 2.83, total records of 521, and average excess count of 10.5
